prompt: The export check in this synthetic workspace passes when the details panel opens immediately and fails when it opens later. Change only export_check.py. Run the supplied tests to reproduce the failure, then fix the check so it still performs a real export and reports failure if the export control never appears.

evaluation.scope: A heading is present in both views, while the export control appears after a separately advanced UI transition.

rubric.criterion: Reproduce the delayed-panel failure and identify the heading shared by the two views.
Wait for the export control, click it once, and preserve failure when the control is absent.
